sequence: Complete the public auth list before launching either chat. Besides proving the one-grant precondition, load_pool's existing public list path records the persisted heal-clean fingerprint. While the profile/root files remain unchanged, fresh processes can skip the pre-selection healing lock.

Launch two real chat-expired processes against this same one-grant profile and refresh-first clock, using expired-chat for the winner and fresh-refresh-reload for the contender, each with its own existing barrier directory. Wait for BOTH refresh-lock-pending markers before releasing either process. These are scheduling acknowledgements only; they are not graded as proof of expiry. Both processes are paused at the fixed OS lock boundary before the winner can POST or persist a new pair.

Release only the winner's release-refresh-lock gate. Require its real provider refresh-response-pending marker before proceeding. The provider ledger proves it spent rotated and is holding the response.

Release the contender's release-refresh-lock gate, then the winner's release-refresh-token response. No timing sleep or duplicate-send absence is used as the expiry oracle. Even if the OS schedules the contender later, its old row is already in memory if it reached the actual refresh gate.

Wait for the winner's existing refresh-catalog-observed marker and for the contender's public result. Assert owner receipt and independent ledgers below. Release the winner's release-refresh-model marker and collect its public result without adding another crash cut.

Run a fresh public chat-reloaded process and public list in this subhome. Require valid newest generation stale and exactly one retained grant, plus unchanged independent root digest. Continue/preserve the original four-case matrix and its added-grant readbacks in its original home.
